name: Jointed shadow puppet
description: Hierarchical jointed figure (parts with pivots) in silhouette (Reiniger) or translucent dyed leather with punched holes (Tholu Bommalata); rods optional. Default part set M.figures.hero is a placeholder to replace with traced silhouettes.

inputs.name: parts
inputs.description: [{id, d, pivot, parent, fill}] in viewBox units

implementation.api: Studio.kit.mythic.puppet(parent, {x, y, h, parts, look}) -> piece with .part(id)

validation.evidence: Kit self-test tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: build, seek determinism) and frame review of the mythic-film scaffold (portrait) on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
